_field_annotations.jsonrpc: JSON-RPC version string — always 2.0 per spec
_field_annotations.id: correlates request to response; server echoes this back
_field_annotations.method: MCP method name — initialize starts the session
_field_annotations.MODEL_CALL_LOCATION: NOT HERE — Gemini runs in week9_mcp_agent.py. Server sees only this JSON message.

_field_annotations.id: echoes request id:1 — confirms which request this answers
_field_annotations.result.serverInfo: server identity — the agent logs this for tracing
_field_annotations.MODEL_CALL_LOCATION: NOT HERE — server has no LLM; it just confirms capabilities.

_field_annotations.method: tools/list — agent asks what tools the server exposes
_field_annotations.params: empty — no pagination or filter in this call
_field_annotations.MODEL_CALL_LOCATION: NOT HERE — agent is asking the server, not asking the LLM.

tools.name: lookup_ingredient

ingredient_name.description:
The ingredient to look up, e.g. 'soy sauce', 'almond flour'.
Case-insensitive. Spell it as it appears in the recipe.

tools.name: list_ingredients
tools.description:
Return the full list of ingredient names in the database.

Use this tool to discover available ingredients before calling
lookup_ingredient, or to show the user which ingredients are indexed.

tools.name: search_ingredients
tools.description:
Search ingredients by partial or approximate name.

Use this before lookup_ingredient when you are unsure of the exact name.
Returns all ingredients whose name contains the search term.

partial_name.description: Partial ingredient name to search for, e.g. 'flour', 'sauce'.

_field_annotations.result.tools: array of tool objects with name, description, inputSchema
_field_annotations.inputSchema: JSON Schema describing the tool parameters — agent converts this to a Gemini FunctionDeclaration
_field_annotations.MODEL_CALL_LOCATION: NOT HERE — server returns static schemas. No LLM on server side.
_field_annotations.next_step: Agent calls mcp_tools_to_gemini() to convert these schemas, then passes them to client.models.generate_content()

_field_annotations.method: tools/call — agent dispatches Gemini's chosen tool call
_field_annotations.params.name: tool name chosen by Gemini in the previous model response
_field_annotations.params.arguments: arguments extracted from Gemini FunctionCall.args dict
_field_annotations.MODEL_CALL_LOCATION: MODEL CALL HAPPENED IN HOST just before this message. Gemini produced a function_call; agent is now dispatching it via JSON-RPC.

text.notes: Contains soy (major allergen) and wheat gluten. Use tamari as GF substitute.

_field_annotations.result.content: array of content items — MCP wraps tool output in content blocks
_field_annotations.result.content[0].type: text — serialised JSON string of the tool return value
_field_annotations.MODEL_CALL_LOCATION: NOT HERE — server executed a Python dict lookup. No LLM. Agent will feed this back to Gemini as a FunctionResponse in the NEXT model call.
_field_annotations.summary: The Gemini LLM runs ONLY in week9_mcp_agent.py. Server processes JSON-RPC; has no idea which model called it.

msg.model_call_location: HOST — inside week9_mcp_agent.py, client.models.generate_content(). NOT in any MCP server.
msg.server_role: MCP servers respond to JSON-RPC calls (initialize, tools/list, tools/call). They run deterministic Python code, not LLM calls.
